description: Tampa CV Pilot Signal Phasing and Timing (SPaT) Sample is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Automobiles", published or maintained by United States Department of Transportation Intelligent Transportation Systems Joint Program Office (JPO) -- Recommended citation: "Tampa Hillsborough Expressway Authority. (2019). Tampa CV Pilot Signal Phasing and Timing (SPaT). [Dataset]. Provided by ITS DataHub through Data.transportation.gov. Accessed YYYY-MM-DD from http://doi.org/10.21949/1504515". The Tampa CV Pilot generates data from the interaction between vehicles and between vehicles and infrastructure. This dataset consists of Signal Phasing and Timing Message (SPaT) Messages transmitted by road-side units (RSU) located throughout the Tampa CV Pilot Study area. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Automobiles". It has 24 columns, among them payload_data_SPAT_intersections_IntersectionState_timeStamp, payload_data_SPAT_regional, metadata_generatedBy, metadata_generatedAt, dataType, randomNum. The portal shows 2021-03-18 as the last data update. Attribution given: United States Department of Transportation Intelligent Transportation Systems Joint Program Office (JPO) -- Recommended . It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution | Share Alike 4.0 International. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
